ops.title: Incident 2026-07-07: token-rotation mass-sweep + relogin clobber (cc-pool v0.46.0)
ops.body:
Anthropic OAuth refresh tokens are single-use; the server revokes the prior access token whenever a chain rotates, so any refresh by any holder instantly 401s every other holder of that account.

Root cause: procscan fails chronically on this fleet (EIO on churning pids). pollOnce read a failed scan as "all accounts idle" and ran synchronized mass-refresh sweeps across the cohort; their tokens were re-minted together and expired together ~8h later, 401ing every live session at once. A running daemon also clobbered interactive relogins.

Fixes shipped in cc-pool v0.46.0:

P0a — fail closed on procscan failure. A failed scan cannot prove any account idle, so every token-spending path (idle refresh + AdoptRotatedToken) is skipped that tick; a successful scan is byte-identical to before. Sites: daemon/scheduler.go pollOnce threads scanOK into pollAccount (idle := scanOK && CountByConfigDir==0 && reservedCount==0); pool/select.go sampleStale + PreflightRefresh; pool/snapshot.go. busy-refresh is also disabled on a failed scan because busyBySession is CountByConfigDir(nil)==0==false. This also closes the relogin clobber race: the `claude /login` child is procscan-visible (execEnv sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), so a fail-closed idle gate reads the account busy for the login's core duration.

P0b — compare-and-swap on the credential write-back. pool/usage.go writeCredCAS + sentinel ErrCredentialChangedUnderfoot: re-read the stored credential immediately before writing and abort if its accessToken no longer matches the snapshot the mutation derived from (refresh: prev.AccessToken; adopt: the cred just read) — claude /login writes the same keychain item with no lock we hold. Narrows the clobber window from minutes to ~ms; a backend read error is not a mismatch (proceeds); refresh returns the abort up, adopt callers log-and-swallow.

P1a — refuse to persist a credential with no accessToken. creds.validateForWrite guards both write funnels (creds.Write keychain + WriteFileCredential file), the write-side mirror of parseCredential's read guard; sentinel ErrNoAccessToken. Closes acct-01's 451x "credential blob has no accessToken" class.

P1b — pool-wide 429 gate. The /usage 429 penalty is per shared-IP bucket, so a 429 on any account gates the whole sweep (and, via the first account, the next sweep) instead of each of 12 peers rediscovering the same 429 and deepening it. daemon/scheduler.go poolRateLimited (rlStreakPool/lastPool429/pool429RetryAfter, scheduler-goroutine-local). The outage canary is exempt (a 429 proves the API is reachable). oauth.go surfaces Retry-After (UsageError.RetryAfter + parseRetryAfter), preferred over the computed backoff but clamped to rateLimitBackoffCap so a hostile/over-long hint can't suspend fleet-wide polling — and every account's needs-login recovery — indefinitely. Cap raised 15m→30m.

P2 (relogin reservation) DEFERRED: the daemon reservation is an in-memory map, not cross-process; wiring `ccp login` to it needs either a new socket RPC or a daemon-eligibility refactor (both out of scope) and is unnecessary given P0a already covers the clobber race. The genuine "relogin doesn't stick" root cause was a separate fileprovider keychain/identity issue handled elsewhere.
